findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger, so recorded calls are lost
findings.body: `LoggerMiddleware` now logs through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. `TestLogger.FromContext` returns a brand-new `TestLogger`, so those calls are recorded on a throwaway instance. The `InfoLogs`/`ErrorLogs` counters on the logger a test injected are never updated. Any test that asserts the middleware logged "Plugin Request Completed" with a `TestLogger` will silently see zero calls. Returning `f` (the receiver) would keep the fake useful.

findings.title: New ContextualLoggerMiddleware and the new FromContext behavior have no tests
findings.body: This PR moves pluginId, endpoint, dsName, dsUID and uname from explicit log parameters into context attributes. These are now set by a new middleware and read back through the new `grafanaInfraLogWrapper.FromContext`. No test checks that the attributes reach the "Plugin Request Completed" log line. The fields now depend on middleware ordering: `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` must come before `LoggerMiddleware`. A future reordering would drop these fields from the data-egress log with nothing to catch it.
